headlines.text: On a Saturday in 2024, back when Mercedes Mone vs. Kris Statlander clashed for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Worlds End, rated 8.58 ? a stone-cold classic. It was the 50th time the AEW TBS Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Mon? hooked Statlander's arms into a pinning predicament for the three count, retaining the TBS Championship in their second classic in as many months.

Looking back to 2022, when The Elite vs. Death Triangle settled things in a Falls Count Anywhere match on Dynamite, rated 8.94 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype in a wild trios sprint, on an outstanding New Year's Smash '22 - Night 1 show that earned an overall rating of 8.34. Kenny Omega put Rey Fenix through a table with a One Winged Angel in a Falls Count Anywhere brawl, tying the best-of-seven Trios Title series at 3-3 and setting up a winner-take-all finale.

On this day in 2024, the AEW Continental Title was up for grabs as Kazuchika Okada vs. Will Ospreay went to war, appearing on Worlds End, rated 9.37 ? an all-timer. Okada hit the Rainmaker to defeat Ospreay and win the 2024 Continental Classic, with a returning Kenny Omega presenting him the title afterward.
